shortDescription: Learn Python from scratch with hands-on examples.

modules.title: Introduction to Python
modules.description: What Python is and why it matters.
modules.content: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its simplicity and readability. It is widely used in web development, data science, automation, and AI.

modules.title: Variables and Data Types
modules.content: Python supports several built-in data types: int, float, str, bool, list, tuple, dict, and set. Variables are dynamically typed — no need to declare a type.
modules.codeExample:
name = 'Alice'
age = 25
height = 5.6
is_student = True
print(name, age, height, is_student)
